classification: TASK-008 all-entries candidate: slice154 flag-elision profile with a static VU1 table of all 2,048 entries generated from the decrypted pinned image (no gameplay recording). Interpreter calls should be zero in every covered scene; the owner slice155 test measured 354,837 interpreted calls in rally and 0 in the night race, to be re-checked in rally, night race and showroom.
preserved_inputs: Production EE library, donor 1b48087 runtime capsule with the VU1 AOT overlay (private/slice155-vu1-full-runtime, receipt identical to slice154), slice153 pacing adapter and nine shaders reused byte-identical from private/slice153-pacing-port and private/slice153-pacing-shaders; slice151-154 build directories untouched.

controls.ctest: CTest 18/18 on private/slice155-vu1-full-build/build (46.5 s); emitter core 110 checks, 0 failures; vu1_aot_registry 426 of 426 entries, 2130 checks, 0 failures; vu_recomp_corpus over the 426-file corpus private/slice155-vu1-full-corpus: 426 programs matched, 1150 checks, 0 failures.
controls.python: unittest discover with GT4_NATIVE_BUILD on the slice155 build: 231 OK, 1 skipped (pre-existing).
controls.headless_smoke: 4200 frames, slice153/154 schedule (12 presses), frames every 100: 42 dumps identical to private/slice154-smoke/final-headless/frames.sha256. vu1_aot compiled_calls=20002 interpreted_calls=0 budget_resumes=0 identity_rejects=0 (per-call counter run).
controls.verify_smoke: GT4_VU1_VERIFY=1 on the same schedule: 42 dumps identical; verified=4300 (top-level calls only), verify_mismatches=0, compiled_calls=20002, interpreted_calls=0.
controls.not_run: No window or gameplay session was launched by the implementing agent; owner measurement is required. The schedule calls only slice154 table entries: the slice154 verify run on the same schedule logged interpreted_calls=0 at 20000 compiled calls, so the 326 new entries are not executed by this schedule. Their execution is covered by the corpus differential only.
controls.ctest_final: Final rebuild and CTest 18/18 after the corpus reconfigure (46 s).

limits: Coverage is static and heuristic: the 426 targeted entries are E-bit successors, branch and jump-link return targets, branch targets, IADDIU constants that can feed JR/JALR, block starts after delay slots, and the previous 100 entries. An entry the EE passes that is outside this set still runs the interpreter (counted as interpreted_calls). Owner scenes are not verified.

The full 8-byte aligned set (2048 entries, 51.5 MB source, 44.6 MB object on a standalone compile) was measured but not used: its source is 21.8 times the slice154 table, above the 3x limit of the decision rule.

The verify counter (verified) covers top-level calls only. Calls made while a verification runs (jump-register dispatch, chained hand-offs) run compiled inside both legs and are not compared with the interpreter individually; this predates slice155.
Elision is per image: a VU1 image uploaded at run time gets its own identity (identity_rejects); a mismatch falls back to the interpreter.
Known limit kept: after an interpreter hand-off or budget resume the FlagPipe history is not transferred (vu_recomp_contract.hpp).
VU1 status is not maintained by emitted code in this image; CFC2 reads VU0 registers only.
The generated source has about 65,000 unused-label warnings in the native build (labels per instruction; the same pattern as slice154, not an error).
Owner gameplay frame measurements are not taken; no speed claim is made from headless runs.
